intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST does the kind of yard clean up Canberra sellers, landlords and tenants need when a property has got away from them and a deadline is coming. That might be an overgrown rental at the end of a lease, a house going on the market, a deceased estate untouched for a year, or a backyard that needs a reset before an inspection. We mow, trim, weed, clear and load, and everything leaves with us the same day.

We are fully insured, ABN registered and locally operated, and we have been doing this since 2021 across Tuggeranong, Belconnen and Queanbeyan. Quotes for a yard clean-up Canberra wide are free and given upfront, so you know what the job covers before we start.

paras: No two properties are the same, so we quote each one on what is actually there. A typical yard clean-up Canberra wide takes in the lawn, the edges, the beds and the rubbish, done in one visit rather than spread over weeks.
Where a place has been empty for months, the grass is often knee high and full of seed heads. We slash it first, then mow it properly, then edge and blow so it looks cared for rather than just cut.
bullets: Long grass slashed, mowed and edged, including nature strips
Overgrown shrubs and hedges cut back so paths, windows and fences are clear
Weeds pulled or sprayed from beds, gravel, pavers and driveways
Old pots, timber, broken furniture and general yard rubbish loaded and removed

sections.h2: How it works, from quote to hand-over
paras: Send us the address, a few photos and your deadline. For an end of lease or pre-sale job the date matters more than anything, so tell us when the inspection or listing is and we will work back from it. You get a free upfront quote, and once you say yes we book a day.

On the day we arrive with the mower, trimmers, saws, rakes and a trailer for the waste. We work through the block front to back, then load everything. Nothing is left on the kerb or in your green bin. For a sale we focus on the front yard and anything visible in listing photos. For an end of lease in Queanbeyan or Jerrabomberra we hand the yard back the way the agent expects, and we can send photos of the finished job. That is the standard for every yard clean up Canberra job we take on.

sections.h2: Why Canberra yards get away from people
paras: Canberra grows in bursts. From September the spring surge turns a tidy lawn into a paddock in a few weeks, and kikuyu and couch run across paths and into beds if nobody is watching. Bindi and broadleaf weeds set seed through late winter and spring, which is exactly when a vacant rental in Kambah or Wanniassa tends to sit unmowed between tenants.

Autumn brings leaf drop from the deciduous street trees in older suburbs like Kaleen and Evatt, and a season of leaves left on a lawn will smother it. The yard clean-up Canberra properties need before winter is mostly about clearing that layer before the frosts.

faqs.q: How far ahead do I need to book a yard clean up in Canberra?
faqs.a: Give us as much notice as you can, especially in spring when demand is high. Tell us the inspection or listing date when you ask for a quote and we will work back from it. Most pre-sale and end of lease yard clean up Canberra jobs are finished in a single visit.

faqs.q: Do you take all the rubbish and green waste away?
faqs.a: Yes. Everything we cut, pull or collect goes with us on the day, including old pots, timber and broken outdoor furniture. Nothing is left at the kerb and we do not fill your green bin. Removal is part of every yard clean-up Canberra quote, not an extra.

faqs.q: Can you clean up a rental in Queanbeyan or Jerrabomberra?
faqs.a: Yes. We cover Queanbeyan and Jerrabomberra as well as Canberra suburbs from Kambah and Wanniassa through to Kaleen and Evatt. A yard clean-up Canberra side of the border or in NSW is quoted the same way, from photos and the address. If you are not sure your address is covered, ask.

faqs.q: Do I need to be there while you work?
faqs.a: No. As long as we can get in through a gate or side access, we can do the job while you are at work or interstate. We send photos of the finished yard on request, which is useful for landlords and tenants dealing with an agent.

faqs.q: Is a clean-up the same as regular garden maintenance?
faqs.a: No. A clean-up is a one-off reset for a property that has been neglected or needs to look right by a set date. Garden maintenance is scheduled, ongoing care. Many customers book a yard clean up Canberra visit first and then move to regular mowing once the yard is back under control.
